detail.title: CP-UVR-0801E1V-I
features: Supports HDCVI, AHD, TVI, CVBS and IP video input
Supports up to 10 channels of IPC access, including 2 additional IP channels + 8  analog channels, with the option to convert all analog channels to IP
8 Channels two-way talk over coaxial cable allows for seamless communication  between the camera, client and recorder
8 Channels IMD+ for analog channels which allows the device to trigger accurate  alarms for humans and vehicles.
8 Channels AI Coding saves on storage and bandwidth while                        maintaining the details of targets in videos
Instastream, H.265, H.264+, H.264 dual stream video compression

General.IMD+ by DVR: 8 Channels: Secondary filtering for human and vehicle, reducing false alarms caused by leaves,  rain and lighting condition change
General.IP Camera Input: Up to 10 Channels of IPC access                                                                                                                   2 IP Channels by default + 8 Channels (analog channels are converted to IP channels)                                          Incoming bandwidth: 40 Mbps, Recording bandwidth: 40 Mbps and Outgoing bandwidth: 40  Mbps                                                                                                                                                                       *After IP extension is enabled, the AI Function (IMD) will be disabled.
General.Video Frame Rate: Main stream: the 1st Channel 1080N/720p@(1fps– 25/30fps), others 1080N/720p@(1fps 15fps), 960H/D1/CIF@(1fps–25/30fps)                                                                                                                   Sub stream: CIF@(1fps–7fps)
General.Video Display Split: When IP extension mode not enabled: 1/4/8/9                                                                                          When IP extension mode enabled: 1/4/8/9/16
General.Video Compression: AI Coding, Instastream, H.265, H.264+, H.264
General.Protocols: HTTP, HTTPS, TCP/IP, IPv4, IPv6, RTSP, UDP, NTP, DHCP, DNS, SMTP, UPnP, IP Filter, FTP,  DDNS, SNMP, Alarm Server, InstaOn, Auto connect, IP Search, ONVIF (Profile T, Profile S,                   Profile G), CGI, SDK
General.Playback Mode: Instant playback, General playback, Event playback, Tag playback, Smart playback
General.General Alarm: Motion detection, HDCVI alarm, Camera external alarm, Network alarm, PIR alarm
General.Abnormality Alarm: Error (No disk, Disk error, Low space, Low quota space, Network disconnection, IP conflict,  MAC conflict), Video loss, Video tampering, Camera offline
General.Alarm Linkage: Record, Snapshot (panoramic), IPC external alarm output, Audio, Buzzer, Log, Preset, Email
General.Two-way Talk: Coaxial two-way talk: 8 Channels BNC                                                                                                              Local and network user two-way talk: Shares the same audio input with the first channel
General.Disk Interface: 1 SATA port, up to 6 TB. This limit varies depending on the environment temperature
